answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by binding identities to optical physical unclonable functions. Nodes direct laser pulses through a unique prism to generate speckle patterns verified against a cryptographic atlas. Forging identities requires manufacturing distinct physical optical tokens, precluding costless virtualization. However, mechanical shock or emitter aging causes speckle drift, occasionally rejecting honest nodes deployed in rugged settings like an open tundra.
